verdict.rationale: Persona supports database lookups and non-document reports (e.g., Address Lookup, Watchlist, PEP, Adverse Media) and database-based identity verification per persona-docs-12 and persona-docs-15, indicating no-document verification paths exist. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms SSN verification, national registry checks, or credit-header data lookups by name, so the specific 'doc-optional' data sources called out in the story are not directly evidenced. missing for 10: explicit mention of SSN verification, national ID/registry database checks, credit-header/credit bureau data verification, and a documented low-friction no-document flow configuration.
